bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
branch=fix/room-position-3-4-20261111
sha=fb5aaa24e85f304261dd927e02bbcccc66bc4dfa
w="$r/.worktrees/room-management-buttons-fb5aaa2"
tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-management-fb5aaa2

test "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 71
if test -d "$w"; then test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 72; else git -C "$r" worktree add --detach "$w" "$sha" >/dev/null || exit 73; fi
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 74

docker build --quiet --pull=false --network=host -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t "$tag" . || exit 76

echo ROOM_MANAGEMENT_BUTTONS_BUILD_PASS
echo SHA="$sha"
